long_biography.plain_text:
Vallot co-founded Stedim in Aubagne with Bernard Lemaître in 1978. Their first products were specialized plastic bags for intravenous nutrition, and the company later adapted single-use systems for biopharmaceutical manufacturing. Vallot combined management with technical invention, receiving patents for flexible bags designed to transport large volumes of biopharmaceutical liquids. He also served as Stedim's vice-chairman and led operating subsidiaries.

The founders took Stedim public before combining it with Sartorius's biotechnology division in 2007. That transaction converted part of Vallot's founder stake into cash and shares after three decades of company-building. He now presides over VAL...INVEST, an investment holding company with substantial financial assets. Outside business, he remains active in Bandol's maritime community as president of a local maritime association.
